ingameEffects.label: String & Melody (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: CRIT DMG is increased. When the equipper enters the battlefield, or activates a Chain Attack or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of Heartstring. Each stack of Heartstring allows the equipper's Chain Attack and Ultimate to ignore a portion of the target's Fire RES, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
